events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed reservation was completed and verified. On the confirmation screen, Atlas was marked Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector Included, with a $280 all-charges-included total. The My reservations list then showed the same saved entry: Confirmed Quarterly planning, Atlas · 12 people · Projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, $280.

Interpretação simulada: The flow let this first-time persona meet all stated constraints efficiently: the room seats all 12 attendees, includes the required projector, carries the requested Quarterly planning purpose, lasts the shown one-hour slot, and stays $70 under the $350 allowance. Persistent summaries at selection, review, confirmation and in My reservations made verification possible without backtracking.

Limites: The site states this is a demo venue and reservations are saved only in this browser session, so long-term persistence, a calendar invitation, and any real-world room availability were not established. The date was shown only as Tomorrow with a 10:00–11:00 time, not as a calendar date.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #5, #11, #13, #15. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Suitable Atlas room verified under the $350 limit
findings.observation: Atlas was listed for 12 seats with an all-in total of $280, shown as $220 room + $35 projector + $25 service, and later confirmed at the same $280 total for 12 people with projector included.
findings.expected: A room for 12 people with a projector and a complete total at or below $350.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and $350 constraint in the saved charter.
findings.personaComment: Atlas fit everyone, had the projector, and came in at $280, so I did not need to keep comparing.
findings.interpretation: Showing capacity, projector inclusion and the all-in breakdown up front reduced the risk of choosing a room that would exceed the budget after fees.
findings.uncertainty: Prices and availability were observed only for Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 in this session.

findings.title: Review and confirmation preserved the requested details accurately
findings.observation: After entering Quarterly planning, the review screen restated that name, seating for 12, projector included, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 and $280 total; the confirmation screen repeated the same name, time, people count, projector status and total with a Confirmed badge.
findings.expected: The entered purpose and the selected room requirements should carry through unchanged to the final reservation.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit purpose Quarterly planning and the product-visible review summary before confirmation.
findings.personaComment: Seeing Quarterly planning, 12 people and the projector on both the review and confirmation pages reassured me it booked correctly.
findings.interpretation: Consistent summaries across steps support trust that no detail was dropped between entry and confirmation.
findings.uncertainty: Only this single test reservation was checked; no edits or corrections were tested.

findings.title: Saved reservation is visible in My reservations
findings.observation: My reservations showed 1 meeting to look forward to, listing Confirmed Quarterly planning at Atlas for 12 people with Projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, priced at $280.
findings.expected: A completed reservation should be retrievable as a saved reservation matching the confirmation.
findings.expectedSource: Saved charter success criterion: the visible saved reservation matches purpose, capacity, projector requirement and budget.
findings.personaComment: Finding the same Quarterly planning booking in My reservations confirmed it was actually saved.
findings.interpretation: A matching saved-reservations entry completes the verification loop beyond the one-time confirmation message.
findings.uncertainty: The footer states reservations are saved only in this browser session, so persistence beyond the session was not verified.

learnings.name: Booking flow sequence
learnings.content: In this session the flow was: choose a room on the landing page, enter a meeting name on Your meeting, proceed via Review booking, verify on Review, then use Confirm reservation to reach a Confirmed page with a View my reservations link.
learnings.subject: Gather room booking flow
learnings.value: Choose room -> Your meeting (meeting name) -> Review booking -> Confirm reservation -> confirmation / My reservations
learnings.confidenceBasis: Each step was directly observed in sequence on screenshots 3, 5, 11 and 13, with the final saved entry on 15.

screenPatterns: What brings you together? meeting-name form
Ready when you are. review page

learnings.name: Atlas price and fit in this session
learnings.content: For Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 in this session, Atlas was shown for 12 people with projector included and an all-in total of $280 CAD, broken down as $220 room for 1 hour + $35 projector + $25 service charge.
learnings.subject: Atlas room listing and summary pricing
learnings.value: $280 all-in: $220 room + $35 projector + $25 service; 12 people; projector included
learnings.confidenceBasis: The same breakdown and total appeared on the selection, details, review and confirmation screens in screenshots 3, 5, 11 and 13; it was not checked for other dates or times.

learnings.name: Saved reservation verification
learnings.content: After confirming, My reservations listed one Confirmed entry named Quarterly planning at Atlas for 12 people with Projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, at $280, matching the confirmation page.
learnings.subject: My reservations list after confirmation
learnings.value: One Confirmed Quarterly planning entry: Atlas, 12 people, Projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, $280
learnings.confidenceBasis: Screenshot 15 directly shows the saved list entry and screenshot 13 shows the matching confirmation details in the same session.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Landing page shows my meeting as Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with projector required, plus Atlas at $280 all-in for 12 seats and Willow at $245 all-in for 12 seats, both available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Atlas is marked as the pick for my team, seats 12 and is $280 all-in — that fits, so I'll go with it.

feedback.summary: Meeting summary and all-in totals shown upfront let me verify fit before choosing
feedback.why: The bar confirms Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with projector required, and Atlas lists 12 seats with a $280 all-in total including projector, so I can confirm it meets capacity and stays under my $350 limit without extra steps.

experience.observation: Details page for Atlas shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included in booking, and a $280 total breakdown, with an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: I need to give this the name Quarterly planning, so I'll click into that field.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and still shows the placeholder example, with the Atlas $280 summary unchanged on the right.
experience.reaction: The field is focused, so I'll type the meeting name now.

experience.observation: Meeting name now reads Quarterly planning, with the Atlas summary still showing Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included and $280 total.
experience.reaction: Quarterly planning is in — I'll head to review to check everything before confirming.

experience.observation: Review page shows Quarterly planning, seating for 12 with projector included, Atlas Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people, and a $280 all-in total.
experience.reaction: This all lines up with what I need, so I'm confirming the reservation.

feedback.summary: Review page restates name, seating, projector and $280 total so I can verify before confirming
feedback.why: It shows Quarterly planning, seating for 12, projector included, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 and the $220 + $35 + $25 = $280 breakdown, letting me check capacity, projector and the $350 limit in one place before committing.

experience.observation: Confirmation page states Quarterly planning is booked at Atlas with a Confirmed badge, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included and a $280 reservation total.
experience.reaction: That's the confirmation I needed — let me verify it appears in my saved reservations too.

feedback.summary: Confirmation page clearly restates the booked details and total
feedback.why: It labels Atlas as Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included and a $280 all-charges-included total, so I can immediately see the reservation meets my capacity, projector and $350 requirements.

charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
